tender.title: Electronic Committee Management System (ECMS).
tender.description:
Caerphilly County Borough Council invites tenders for the provision, implementation, support and maintenance of a comprehensive Electronic Committee Management System (ECMS).
The Council requires a modern, secure, cloud-hosted solution to support the administration and governance of democratic services and committee management activities. The solution must facilitate the efficient creation, management, publication and archiving of committee agendas, reports, minutes, decisions and associated meeting documentation.
The Council requires a fully bilingual (English and Welsh) system that supports the needs of elected Members, officers and the public whilst ensuring compliance with Welsh Language Standards, accessibility requirements, data protection legislation and recognised security standards.
The solution should provide functionality including, but not limited to:
•	Committee, meeting and calendar management.
•	Agenda, report and minutes production workflows.
•	Decision and action tracking.
•	Public-facing committee information and publication portal.
•	Secure Member and officer access via desktop, tablet and mobile devices.
•	Bilingual content management and publication.
•	Electronic distribution of meeting papers.
•	Meeting attendance and voting management.
•	Document storage, search and retrieval functionality.
•	Integration with Microsoft 365 and other relevant Council systems.
•	Role-based access controls and audit reporting.
•	Management information and performance reporting.
The successful supplier will be responsible for:
•	Solution provisioning and implementation.
•	System configuration and data migration where required.
•	User acceptance testing support.
•	Training for system administrators, officers and elected Members.
•	Ongoing software maintenance, upgrades and technical support.
Full details can be found in the ITT (Tender Pack)

tender.title: Case Management Migration
tender.description:
The contract comprises the provision of programme, project management and testing services to support Warwickshire County Council's migration of its Mosaic social care case management system, Abacus and Synergy including case management from on‑premise hosting to a cloud‑hosted environment.
The scope of services includes the planning, coordination and delivery of a "lift and shift" (like‑for‑like) transition of these applications to The Access Group's cloud hosting platform. The migration will ensure continuity of service, system accessibility, and operational integrity for social care users, without introducing new functionality at the point of go‑live.
The provider will deliver a structured testing approach covering all core system components, including connectivity and access, administrative functions, workflows, forms, reference data, finance and commissioning modules, and reporting and business intelligence outputs. Testing will include multiple user acceptance testing (UAT) cycles, dry run validation and go‑live readiness activities.
The contract includes responsibility for programme governance, project management, test management, and business intelligence support. Key deliverables include assurance that the applications remain accessible to all intended users, that existing workflows and processes function in line with the current configuration, and that users are able to access historic records and continue case management activities following migration.
tender.procurementMethodRationale:
Permanent Futures were successful in an initial procurement exercise to find a partner to support the migration. Having completed the activities from the procurement exercise, it has become clear that the current delivery vehicle could be enhanced through further external support.
Having completed the initial contract, the supplier has enabled the planned delivery of services, and therefore removing them from the project at this stage would create disproportionate technical difficulties for the Council if an alternative supplier was appointed.

tender.title: Clinical Diagnosis and Treatment
tender.description:
The purpose of this framework is for the provision of Clinical Diagnosis & Treatment services that fall under the Lots listed in the ITT.
Services offered under this framework will meet the highest industry standards and support Beneficiaries with the current and future day-to-day activities in respect of the requirements.
The intention is to offer an accessible and compliant route to market for organisations to easily manage multiple services, assisting Beneficiaries in the management of waiting list within services to meet NHS targets.
The framework will be comprised of 9 lots:
• Lot 1 - Dermatology
• Lot 2 - Oral and Maxillofacial surgery
• Lot 3 - Audiology
• Lot 4 - Ophthalmology
• Lot 5 - ENT (Ear, Nose & Throat)
• Lot 6 - Gastroenterology
• Lot 7 - Urology
• Lot 8 - Endoscopy
• Lot 9 - Managed Services
This is the first reopening of the framework as described in the original framework documents -  2025/S 000-055693
The term of the framework will be 2 years plus an optional one year extension. 
This framework is being run under the Provider Selection Regime.
The framework is for the benefit of existing and emerging organisations during the life of the Contract and is intended to
support Relevant Authorities when procuring such services. 
Relevant authorities as follows:
• NHS England
• Integrated care boards (ICBs)
• NHS trusts and NHS foundation trusts
• Local authorities and combined authorities.
This framework is not accessible by Authorities in Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland.
